references.text: Israel becomes a proverb and an object of mockery among the nations, fulfilling the warning in Deuteronomy
Jeremiah prophesies that Judah will become a horror, a proverb, and an object of mockery among all peoples
The prophecy that the land will become a desolation, a horror, and an object of mockery
The same theme of becoming a horror, an object of mockery, and a curse among all nations
Ezekiel prophesies that Jerusalem will become an object of mockery and derision among the surrounding peoples
The Lord will make the disobedient into a sign and a proverb
The psalmist laments that Israel has become a proverb among the Gentiles
The psalmist describes how he has become a proverb and an object of mockery
Parallel text to 1 Kings 9:7 about Israel becoming a proverb and an object of mockery
